native_build_mode: zig build install -Doptimize=ReleaseFast -Ds31-version=1 -Ds31-fri-fold-step=1; fresh package paths and native prover/verifier processes

prospective_design.comparison: same committed semantic S31 source, same assignment and public claim; separate generic and authenticated-general-mixed packages and native verifiers
prospective_design.order: deterministic balanced AB/BA order, 50 assignments each; record order and process start times
prospective_design.summary: per-pair median log(generic/mixed) and 95% paired bootstrap interval, paired by assignment; report absolute costs too

process_wrapper: fresh prover and native verifier OS processes per trial; Python perf_counter; native runtime timers recorded separately

rss_uncertainty.calibration: For each training program, fit the center on other V8r1 training programs, collect every trial residual, and take max(abs(p05),abs(p95)); radius is max of those absolute radii, their residual-to-center relative radii times the prediction center, and the fixed absolute floor. Clip lower at zero.
rss_uncertainty.center_fit: V7 family-specific point fits, refit from fresh V8r1 training observations only

selection_policy: Automatic lowering disabled; local pinned-stack prediction only
shape_reuse_disclosure: Finite direct-chip powers of two and fixed-width division forms repeat earlier shapes. Source and assignment bytes are disjoint; shape novelty is not claimed.

v7r1_diagnostic_disclosure.use_of_v7r1_validation: motivated the prospective uncertainty method and size-stratified design only; no V7r1 held-out trial, coefficient, interval, or gate result may enter V8 fitting or calibration

v8_fit_failure_disclosure.failure: signed_128_result protocol key was not mapped to inherited V3 signed_128_output case-roster checker
v8_fit_failure_disclosure.reuse_policy: V8 training corpus, package measurements, proof measurements, and any fit result are excluded from V8r1 fitting and calibration; V8r1 uses fresh source and assignment bytes and reruns native train and heldout phases after new external anchors
